_comment: Paste the mcpServers block below into Cline > MCP Settings (cline_mcp_settings.json). Option A (Docker) runs the exact image CI builds from this repository — recommended. Option B (npx) runs the npm release channel. Use ONE of them, not both. The version pin (1.15.0) matches mcp-server/package.json; scripts/check-version-sync.mjs validates it.

_alternative_npx.note: npm channel — same package, no Docker required. Keep the version pinned; @latest may drift from the audited repo tree.
